title: Story premise ENT096: The Key That Lived in the Other Pocket
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (everyday microdramas). Hook: I checked that pocket. I checked that pocket again. Takeaway/theme: Make a repeated search visible and give the item a repeatable home.
description: A commuter wants to leave on time, but searches the same jacket pocket after every distraction. They empty both pockets onto two labeled circles, spot the key under a folded note, and choose a single small tray by the exit for its return that evening.
